metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: An epic adventure about the bond between a boy and a dragon, featuring martial-arts style action similar to Kung Fu Panda.

metas.name: Big Hero 6
metas.description: A high-tech superhero adventure that fans of the Spider-Verse movies and Sonic the Hedgehog will love.

metas.name: The Incredibles
metas.description: A hilarious and action-packed look at a family of superheroes, perfect for kids who enjoyed the Spider-Verse series.

metas.name: Inside Out
metas.description: A creative and colorful journey through the human mind, similar in emotional depth to Turning Red.

metas.name: Luca
metas.description: A beautiful story of friendship and summer adventures that captures the same magical feeling as Ponyo.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: A high-energy, visually unique family comedy that matches the fast-paced humor of Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse.

metas.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
metas.description: A zany and imaginative comedy that fans of The Super Mario Bros. Movie and Despicable Me will enjoy.

metas.name: Wreck-It Ralph
metas.description: An adventure set inside video games, making it a perfect companion to the Sonic and Mario movies.

metas.name: Megamind
metas.description: A funny twist on the superhero genre focusing on a villainous main character, similar to The Bad Guys.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 3
metas.description: The direct continuation of Po's journey for fans who have already seen the first two films.

metas.name: Madagascar
metas.description: A hilarious animal-centric adventure with great comedy, much like Rio and Migration.

metas.name: Ice Age
metas.description: A classic group-adventure film with plenty of slapstick humor for fans of Migration.

metas.name: Monsters, Inc.
metas.description: A heartwarming and imaginative story about monsters who are more scared of children than they are scary.

metas.name: The Secret World of Arrietty
metas.description: A gentle and beautiful Studio Ghibli film about tiny people, perfect for fans of My Neighbor Totoro.

metas.name: Up
metas.description: A grand, emotional adventure involving a flying house and a talking dog that fans of Finding Nemo will enjoy.

metas.name: Bolt
metas.description: An action-filled comedy about a dog who believes he has real superpowers, much like the Sonic movies.

metas.name: Over the Hedge
metas.description: A funny group of forest animals getting into mischief, similar to the humor found in Migration.

metas.name: The Croods
metas.description: A prehistoric family adventure that is filled with physical comedy and heart.

metas.name: Smallfoot
metas.description: A musical comedy that flips the Yeti legend upside down, appealing to fans of Sing and Moana.

metas.name: Abominable
metas.description: A magical journey across beautiful landscapes that shares the adventure spirit of Raya and the Last Dragon.

metas.name: A Bug's Life
metas.description: A classic Pixar adventure about tiny heroes, perfect for kids who love the Toy Story franchise.

metas.name: Finding Dory
metas.description: The wonderful sequel to Finding Nemo that follows Dory on her own quest to find her family.

metas.name: Cars
metas.description: A fun, character-driven story about racing and friendship for fans of the high-speed Sonic movies.

metas.name: Despicable Me 2
metas.description: More hilarious Minion antics and family growth for those who enjoyed the first movie.

metas.name: Horton Hears a Who!
metas.description: A whimsical Dr. Seuss adaptation with bright animation and a positive message.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania
metas.description: A silly, family-friendly take on classic monsters that focuses on comedy rather than scares.

metas.name: Rise of the Guardians
metas.description: An epic fantasy action movie that brings childhood legends together like an animated superhero team.

metas.name: Onward
metas.description: A magical quest between two brothers that captures the fantasy elements seen in Raya and the Last Dragon.

metas.name: Soul
metas.description: A visually stunning and music-filled journey that shares the cultural heart of Coco.

metas.name: Wish
metas.description: A recent Disney musical adventure that celebrates the magic of wishing and heroics.

metas.name: Elemental
metas.description: A creative Pixar film about elements living together, similar in style to Zootopia and Encanto.

metas.name: The Peanuts Movie
metas.description: A wholesome and charming adventure featuring the beloved Snoopy and Charlie Brown.

metas.name: Turbo
metas.description: A fast-paced story about a snail with super-speed, perfect for fans of Sonic the Hedgehog.

metas.name: Epic
metas.description: A hidden-world adventure with beautiful animation similar to The Sea Beast.

metas.name: The Princess and the Frog
metas.description: A classic hand-drawn musical adventure with great songs and characters like Moana.

metas.name: Mulan
metas.description: A brave and action-packed story about a hero finding her strength, similar to Raya and the Last Dragon.

metas.name: Hercules
metas.description: A funny and energetic musical adventure based on Greek mythology.

metas.name: Tarzan
metas.description: An exciting jungle adventure with an iconic soundtrack that fans of The Lion King will appreciate.

metas.name: The Emperor's New Groove
metas.description: A purely comedic adventure with fast-paced humor similar to Shrek and The Bad Guys.
